verdict.rationale: Graphite ships an official MCP server (gt-mcp) which is the standard mechanism for exposing tools to agents like Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex, and its own review UI offers one-click 'suggested fixes' and an in-house Agent that can open PRs from natural-language descriptions. However, there is no documentation explicitly naming Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex as integration targets, nor any mention of a 'copyable fix prompt' format for handing findings to an external agent. missing for 10: explicit named integration or workflow docs for Claude Code/Cursor/Codex, evidence of a copy-paste prompt export feature, and any hands-on confirmation that gt-mcp actually surfaces review findings to those agents.
